text.name: Trevenant

attacks.name: Shadow Cage
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

text.flavor: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

text.name: Phantump
text.flavor: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

text.name: Hatenna
text.flavor: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

text.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Scorch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

text.flavor: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

text.name: Lampent

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Top Entry
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you drew this Pokémon from your deck at the beginning of your turn and your Bench isn't full, before you put it into your hand, you may put it onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Reignite
attacks.text: Attach a {Fire} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

text.name: Chandelure

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Protective Glow
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have Energy attached have no Weakness.

attacks.name: Mirage Flare
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Energize
attacks.text: Attach a {Lightning} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

text.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Sleep Pulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

text.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Life Sucker
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

text.name: Haunter
text.flavor: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

text.name: Gengar

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Last Gift
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Pain Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

text.name: Misdreavus
text.flavor: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

text.name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Ominous Prose
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. If they have 4 or more cards in their hand, choose all but 3, and your opponent shuffles the chosen cards into their deck.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

text.name: Duskull

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

text.name: Dusclops

attacks.name: Fade to Black
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

text.name: Dusknoir

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Special Transfer
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move a Special Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

text.flavor: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

text.name: Cubone
text.flavor: It wears its mother's skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it's clear that it's always crying.

text.name: Hattrem

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

text.name: Hatterene

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Witch Rondo
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

text.name: Pumpkaboo

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Pumpkin Pit
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Stadium in play.

text.flavor: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

text.name: Gourgeist

attacks.name: Pandemonium
attacks.text: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. This attack does 60 damage for each {Psychic} Pokémon you find there. Then, shuffle those Pokémon back into your deck and discard the other cards.

text.flavor: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

text.name: Mimikyu

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Heal Jamming
abilities.text: Your opponent's Benched Pokémon can't be healed.

text.flavor: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

text.name: Sinistea

attacks.name: Furtive Drop
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

text.name: Polteageist

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Tea Break
abilities.text: You must discard a Pokémon that has the Mad Party attack from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

text.flavor: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

text.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Hide in Shadows
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

text.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

text.flavor: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

text.name: Spinarak
text.flavor: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

text.name: Ariados

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Spider Net
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Evolution Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

text.name: Nickit
text.flavor: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

text.name: Darkrai

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Darkness Guard
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any {Darkness} Energy attached, it takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Vortex of Darkness
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each {Darkness} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
